title: A catalyst family of high-entropy alloy atomic layers with square atomic arrangements comprising iron- and platinum-group metals.

recollection.starting_material: Guess: transition metals such as iron and platinum-group metals
recollection.intervention: Guess: high-entropy alloy formation and atomic layer creation
recollection.mechanism: Guess: catalyst activity due to unique atomic arrangement and high-entropy alloy properties
recollection.results: Guess: enhanced catalytic performance and possibly improved stability

score.note: The recollection only restates title-level concepts: forming high-entropy-alloy atomic layers with square arrangements. It omits the Pd nanocube core, quinary shell composition and synthesis, random metastable FCC structure, specific adsorption/electron-transfer mechanism, and all numerical HER/HOR, durability, DFT, and thermal-transition results.
